data.name: Paragraph1
data.value: Want to learn Dutch without joining group classes? Our ten-week courses let you study grammar, sentence patterns, pronunciation, and culture at your own pace, wherever you prefer. We support you whenever questions arise, and halfway through the course you can join an optional speaking-practice session with other learners.

data.name: Paragraph2
data.value: Use the course as a confident start to life among Dutch speakers or as preparation for the integration exams.
